classification: post-hoc three-sleeve diversification experiment after R335-R337 5x cost fragility
hypothesis: Adding the independently researched R257 quality-relative-strength sleeve as a third equity profit source will broaden 5x-cost net stock P&L without weakening the existing no-leverage and concentration gates.
disclosure: R334/R335 showed that the A+B portfolio stayed profitable at 5x but stock net contribution remained too concentrated. R336 changed TopN and R337 lengthened the B holding period; both failed. R338 does not change any stock strategy or defensive asset. It combines three already researched sleeves under one frozen three-way risk budget.

C.data_limitation: R257 factor first valid date is 2023-05-04; no backfill or synthetic history is allowed.

evaluation_window.reason: Common period in which all three sleeves have valid factor data.

fixed_construction.stock_execution: T+1 open, equal weight within each sleeve, 10 positions per sleeve
fixed_construction.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity across A/B/C, each weight bounded [0.20,0.60], no leverage
fixed_construction.equity_risk_share: monthly equity sleeve at most 1/3 of total portfolio risk budget
fixed_construction.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross exposure [0.2,1.0], no leverage

data.D1: all three strategy files and required factor columns load without error
data.D2: R257 C factor coverage on historical HS300 >=99% over the common window
data.D5: mean pairwise daily return correlation across sleeves below 0.85

performance_2x.G9_incremental: Sharpe >= A+B two-sleeve control +0.05 or MDD >= control +3pp, while annual >= control -1pp
performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max gross weight <=1 and min target weight >=0
performance_2x.G11_sleeve_balance: mean weight of each sleeve >=0.15 and <=0.60

costs.X2_5x_performance: total return >0, Sharpe >=0.50, MDD >= -25%, 2024/2025 both >=0, recent year >0

concentration_2x_and_5x.C9_asset_weight: each defensive asset mean <=40% and max <=50%
concentration_2x_and_5x.C10_liquidity: R331 primary asset liquidity gate passes
concentration_2x_and_5x.C12_weights: max weight sum <=1 and min target weight >=0

robustness.F1_fresh_starts: at least 4/5 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay_plateau: at least 7/9 combinations of 40/60/90-day lookback and 12/15/18% target pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint_target: at least 2/3 joint equity/overlay target variants pass core gates

selection_rule: All D/G/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise record R338 as a negative result, keep R334 research_only_cost_fragile, and continue with a new preregistered hypothesis. No threshold may be relaxed after reading results.
discipline: No TopN or sleeve weight grid.
No paper target or order file.
known_limitations: The common window starts in 2023 because the R257 factor has no earlier valid history.
R257 was previously research-only with its own concentration failure; its inclusion here is a portfolio-diversification hypothesis, not independent proof of its standalone quality.
The industry map is a current snapshot; financial data use available announcement-date logic but are not a full vendor PIT reproduction.
ETF qfq series are not official PIT total-return benchmarks.
This is an in-sample post-hoc candidate.
